stories.title: Distance Field Contract for Chat Messages
stories.description: Define and document the frontend contract for provider distance fields (e.g., distance_miles:number, distance_text:string) within chat message payloads to ensure consistent parsing and rendering in MessageBubble.
stories.evidence: GAP: MessageBubble.tsx renders markdown only; no explicit structured distance schema defined

stories.title: Distance Formatting Logic
stories.description: Implement client-side formatting logic to convert raw distance values into user-friendly strings (e.g., rounding, units in miles, fallback text like 'Distance unavailable') prior to rendering.

stories.title: Render Distance in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Enhance MessageBubble component to display formatted distance inline with provider results while preserving markdown rendering, spacing, and readability within chat responses.

stories.title: End-to-End Distance Data Integration
stories.description: Ensure distance values from backend (MAINT-DIST) are propagated through chat response payloads and correctly consumed by the frontend contract without loss or mismatch.

stories.title: Distance Display Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and UI tests validating distance formatting, rendering correctness in MessageBubble, and graceful handling of missing or null distance values.
